name: 1Password

fastest.text: Sign in on 1Password.com, select Billing in the sidebar and choose Cancel subscription.

steps: Sign in to your account on 1Password.com in a web browser.

faq.a: Your subscription stays active until the end of the billing period, then the account is frozen. You can still sign in, view and copy items and export your data, but you can't add or edit items or autofill in the browser.
No. 1Password doesn't refund past charges or unused time when you cancel.
Yes. Sign in on 1Password.com, select Billing and choose Subscribe to unfreeze the account.
